definitions.exposure: Equal weight per distinct user/day/history context, then equal weight per seed within family
definitions.familiar_top10_share: Fraction of top-10 tokens in the supplied history; Yambda history is the last 48 listens, not lifetime history
definitions.top10_overlap_with_baseline: Intersection size divided by ten, averaged over distinct user/day/history contexts within user, then across users; paired SFT seed
definitions.series_share: Metadata content_type=series; not a proxy for runtime
definitions.top_items: Descriptive exposure counts, not observed responses to the new policy
definitions.modal_top1_user_macro_share: For the global modal top-1 token counted over distinct contexts, average the within-user distinct-context share, then average users equally
definitions.users_ever_modal_top1_fraction: Fraction of users with that global modal top-1 item in at least one distinct context
definitions.users_majority_modal_top1_fraction: Fraction of users with that global modal top-1 item in strictly more than half of their distinct contexts
definitions.n_behavior_users: Number of users represented by the distinct contexts; same denominator for all three modal-item user summaries
